scope: Native spatial evidence upgrade; full raw-row computation; separately labeled historical context; no new aligned condition contrast

full_validation.scope: Full native object reconstructions and descriptive export measurements; historical results retained as context; no new aligned condition contrast.

native_validation.raw_hashes: Reused full SHA-256 inventory records; this run checked sizes and row counts without redundant input rehash.

browser_checks: native association with explicit denominator support
Synchronized zoom updates both coordinate ranges
Current findings and distinctly historical figures
Final perceptual count colors and upload control disabled
presentation_refresh: After full notebook execution, disabled optional Plotly cloud-sharing control; rebuilt offline HTML, reran2assemblytests and browser-checked. Measured payloads and notebook result outputs unchanged.

native_atlas_parameters.json.bin_width_selection: Exploratory display choices in unverified native units; not transferred physical calibration or the accepted COMET grid.
native_atlas_parameters.json.grid_origin: Integer multiples of each width enclosing all exported bounding boxes; each export has independent native extents.
native_atlas_parameters.json.sampling: Fixed seeded uniform sample without replacement within each export/class, sorted back to source row order. Class caps avoid overwhelming PLA by the much larger ChAT class; samples are not prevalence estimates.

review_targets.meaning: Native windows for manual source-image review only; selected extremes are not prevalence estimates or spatial inference.

morphology_object_review_targets.selection: Select PLA source records from the full parsed export before display downsampling. Preserve source order within diameter-QC categories; stable source-order ties for minimum/maximum positive finite area. An object may appear under several review reasons.
morphology_object_review_targets.meaning: At most eight targeted selection records per export, not representative samples or unique-object counts. Every reviewed object remains in the raw PLA and ChAT-flag denominators. Ratio-ineligible objects remain eligible for area review when area is finite and positive.

native_atlas_parameters.json.diameter_ratio: minimum / maximum, finite min>=0 and max>0 and min<=max; zero minimum with positive maximum retained.
native_atlas_parameters.json.orientation: Native screen convention: x increases right and y increases down; no anatomical labels.
native_atlas_parameters.json.boundary_rule: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive except final maximum edge inclusive; internal boundaries enter the next bin.
native_atlas_parameters.json.zero_semantics: 0 means no selected exported detection midpoint in this rectangular search bin. It is not a tissue-valid zero or evidence of absent tissue.
native_atlas_parameters.json.raw_counts: All finite ordered boxes contribute once per source row. No smoothing, tissue-area normalization, registration or cross-export pooling.
native_atlas_parameters.json.scientific_status: Exploratory export QC; not accepted aligned COMET condition-difference maps.

explorer_display_parameters.json.scope: Display-only starting values for the saved native atlas; no effect on raw analysis or biological inclusion.
explorer_display_parameters.json.count_colour_palette: Magma-style sequential scale for PLA; amber for ChAT; shared class/bin limits; zero-count bins blank with unknown tissue status
explorer_display_parameters.json.minimum_support_interpretation: Interactive display filter for a descriptive fraction; not a validated cutoff or transferred historical parameter.
explorer_display_parameters.json.coordinate_display: Native Y increases downward; units and anatomical orientation unverified.
explorer_display_parameters.json.scale_policy: Identical colour limits across all exports for each object class, bin width and transform.
explorer_display_parameters.json.point_sampling: Use the deterministic samples recorded in the native-atlas analysis payload; all eligible rows feed count maps.

descriptive_findings_parameters.json.candidate_pair_display_rule: left fraction of distinct shared exported measurement signatures > 0.8; selected for review, not proof of section identity
descriptive_findings_parameters.json.area_intervals_meaning: Object distribution quantiles, not confidence intervals or animal uncertainty
descriptive_findings_parameters.json.count_change_denominator: PLA count of left export in each displayed pair
descriptive_findings_parameters.json.association_change_units: Percentage points, right export minus left export
descriptive_findings_parameters.json.association_denominator: All PLA-labelled rows of each export; no morphology exclusions
